[[File:FiveYears.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The painting, ''Five Years of Galaxies'']]
'''''Five Years of Galaxies''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] head, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on a [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] embracing [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and some [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]. It was made to commemorate some sort of saga called ''[[Star Wars]]''.

==Description==
The painting included some text in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], including ''Star Wars''&mdash;the title of what was being commemorated&mdash;as well as a list of ambiguous names, possibly [[entertainer]]s within the saga being noted. The painting seemed to speculate that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] would "strike back." This was quite ominous, given that the Empire did in fact strike back during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], years after the painting was created.

==History==
One of many paintings and other pieces of art available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], ''Five Years of Galaxies'' was most prevalent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It appeared some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and was a pivotal conflict in the war. Leia and Vader issued these paintings, alongside ''[[Six Years of Galaxies]]'' and various medals, during the festivities of [[Remembrance Day]] and [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]], respectively.<ref name="Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Wars_Galaxies_Five_Years.jpg|thumb|120px|5 Year anniversary logo.]]
This painting was only given out to players for the fifth year anniversary of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] live event of [[2008]].

This painting is actually the theatrical poster for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], a [[1980]] movie made by [[George Lucas]] as the fifth chronological installment of ''Star Wars''.

Unlike most of the other theatrical posters in the game, ''Five Years of Galaxies'' is not named after its movie counterpart, ''The Empire Strikes Back.''
